title: plan-run phase-worker result
description: The structured result a phase worker returns to the orchestrator. Exactly one of the two shapes is valid, selected by `outcome.result`: DONE carries the completion evidence, BLOCKED carries the unresolved decision. The two are mutually exclusive and the schema enforces that — a DONE cannot carry a `question`, and a BLOCKED cannot claim `verification`.

outcome.description: The phase result. Choose the branch matching what actually happened; never half-finish a phase.

anyOf.title: DONE
anyOf.description: The phase's work is complete and left uncommitted.

result.description: The phase's work is complete and left uncommitted.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what changed.

changed_surface.description: The files and sections touched, for the phase document's Evidence record.

verification.description: The exact verification commands run and their outcomes, including the scoped tests and the lint/type-check over the changed surface.

deviations.description: Doc-vs-reality corrections made to the phase document, or the string "none".

anyOf.title: BLOCKED
anyOf.description: A genuine decision could not be resolved from the three on-disk inputs. No partial work to rely on.

result.description: A genuine decision could not be resolved from the three on-disk inputs.

changed_surface.description: The files this attempt touched and did not revert, so the orchestrator can scope a cleanup to them (`git restore -- <paths>`; delete only files you created) instead of a blanket reset that would discard unrelated uncommitted work. Use "none" when you reverted your own edits or made none — which is preferred, since you know exactly what you touched.

question.description: The single decision that cannot be resolved from plan.md, execution.md, and the phase document.

recommendation.description: The worker's best option and why — an orchestrator running autonomously will take it and record it as an assumption.
